text: Pattison Outdoor (the "Applicant"), on behalf of the property owner, has applied to seek variances to the Sign By-law, required to allow for the erection and display of one third party wall sign (the "Proposed Wall Sign"). The Proposed Wall Sign is an illuminated wall sign, to be located on the easterly facing elevation of the existing building located at the premises municipally known as 2883-2885 Bloor Street West. The Proposed Wall Sign will have one sign face, displaying static copy, and measuring 6.10 metres horizontally by 3.05 metres vertically. The highest point of the Proposed Wall Sign measured from grade, would be 4.32 metres. Upon review of the Applicant's submission, staff submit that the two variances required for the Proposed Wall Sign should be granted, based largely on the Applicant's previous ability to obtain an as-of-right permission respecting a similar sign, and…

The Sign Variance Committee: 1. Refused to grant the two variances requested to §§ 694-25B(1)(a) and 694-25B(1)(b) required to allow the issuance of a permit for the erection and display of one third party wall sign on the property municipally known as 2883-2885 Bloor Street West, as described in Attachment 1 to the report (March 5, 2018) from the Manager, Sign By-law Unit, Toronto Building.
